item.title: Security Add-On
item.creator: Dodo Studios
item.description:
Use the best security tools in your own world!

Security cameras
Lasers and laser turrets
Drones
Traps
Secret doors
Teleporters
Alarms with motion sensors
Chunk claimer
and much more security tools!

faqEntries.heading: Do the Security Cameras work?
faqEntries.content: Yes! You can place Security Cameras and Night Vision Cameras anywhere. Interact with a Computer, Laptop, or CCTV Monitor to view them from anywhere in the world.

faqEntries.heading: How do the Alarms work?
faqEntries.content: If a player walks through lasers or enters a wrong access code, they set off an alarm. When an alarm is triggered, it activates nearby Alarm Lights and Alarm Sirens, allowing you to hear and see the alert in your entire base.

faqEntries.heading: What’s the difference between the Scanners?
faqEntries.content:
There are 3 different scanners to open Protected Doors:
- Biometric Scanner, scans your face
- Keycard Scanner, scans the keycard item you’re holding
- PIN Code Keypad, asks for a password you can create

faqEntries.heading: Do the Secret Doors work with any texture pack?
faqEntries.content: Yes! The Secret Doors work with any texture pack. They stay completely hidden, even for players using a different texture pack, making them perfect for secret rooms!

faqEntries.heading: Does it work for Multiplayer?
faqEntries.content: Absolutely! Security Add-On is designed with multiplayer in mind. You can add specific players as Friends, allowing them to interact with your security models. And you can also place Chunk Claimers to claim and protect areas.

faqEntries.heading: Can I change settings?
faqEntries.content: Yes! The Add-On includes both Personal Settings and Admin Settings, allowing you to customize a wide range of features. Only players with /op permissions can change the Admin Settings.

howToEntries.heading: 1. Craft a Security Chip
howToEntries.content: Craft Security Chips with 1x Iron Ingot and 4x Redstone. You need the chip to craft the security models.

howToEntries.heading: 2. Setup Security Cameras
howToEntries.content: Craft and place Security Cameras. Interact with Computers to access your cameras from anywhere in the world.

howToEntries.heading: 3. Place Protected Doors
howToEntries.content: Secure your base by placing Protected Doors. These doors can only be opened using a Scanner. If another player tries to open one, they will set off an alarm.

howToEntries.heading: 4. Build Your Security System
howToEntries.content: Security Cameras and Protected Doors are just the beginning. You can also craft Drones, Traps, Teleporters, Private Chests, Lasers, Chunk Claimers, and more. Include them all to fully protect your base!

howToEntries.heading: 5. Optional: Add Friends
howToEntries.content: You can add Friends through the Settings item. Friends can interact with your Scanners and private Security Cameras, making it easy to share your base without giving everyone access.
